title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah ayat enam Pasal satu Undang-Undang Nomor 944 yang berjudul "Undang-Undang Pengurangan Jumlah Kotamadya dari Tiga Puluh Tiga Menjadi Dua Puluh Dua di Provinsi Cagayan"
title.ms: Akta mengubah perenggan enam Seksyen Satu Akta Nombor 944 yang bertajuk "Akta Pengurangan Bilangan Perbandaran daripada tiga puluh tiga kepada dua puluh dua di Wilayah Cagayan"

text.en:
Paragraph six of section one of Act Numbered Nine hundred and forty-four, entitled "An Act
reducing the thirty-three municipalities of the Province of Cagayan to twenty-two," is hereby amended by
inserting after the words "barrios of" in the third line of said paragraph, the word "Buguey."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 6, 1903.
